scope: First bounded physical iPad run of a freshly prepared Solitaire candidate using the current local HLE and Relinker. This report covers this single completed run and its rollback, not later isolation runs.

candidate.note: Archive contents, embedded build provenance, candidate manifest and device runtime readbacks were matched. Host CPU/API checks and a complete dependency audit do not establish game compatibility.

observed_result.visual_result: Library view with error dialog at 35 and 60 seconds, as reviewed by the root task; sanitized local OCR independently found Library, Solitaire and Error/Exception text at both times.
observed_result.image_privacy_note: Captures include unrelated notification content and remain private; only their hashes are recorded here.

cause_under_investigation.analysis: Separate read-only static analysis traces a 48-byte allocation during a guest constructor into the bundled libc allocator, whose initialization state is unset. It then raises bad_alloc and terminates with a deliberate UD2 instruction. The same analysis finds that the newly generated launcher omitted the bundled libc initialization call present in the earlier launcher.
cause_under_investigation.public_source_corroboration: At the pinned AnyPS5 commit, WindowsGuestModuleWriter records guest lifecycle entry points only when ReplacementModule is empty; a converted guest module with replacement imports can therefore lose its initialization metadata.
cause_under_investigation.alternative_interpretations_not_excluded: This capture alone does not prove the allocator was the sole cause or validate a repair. A dependency-complete package can still fail before graphics.

rollback.helper_cleanup: Termination raced an already exited helper; final exact-bundle process inventory was empty.

limitations: This freshly prepared executable changed together with HLE; the first run does not isolate the regression to one component.
No Vulkan device, game draw, visible game frame, GPU shader execution or game rendering qualification was reached in the captured run.
No Solitaire gameplay, audio, controls, save/load, background handling, resource stability or FPS acceptance.
Independent offscreen color/stencil probe results do not turn this failed startup into a successful game integration.
Later old-launcher/new-HLE isolation and lifecycle-repair candidates are separate experiments and are not results of this run.
No private game bytes, disassembly, raw shaders, paths or screenshots are published by this report.
